summary.zh: 冰水面糊、薄如蝉翼的面衣，「蒸」与「炸」在瞬间同时发生的艺术。
summary.en: Ice-cold batter, a veil-thin crust — the art of steaming and frying at the same instant.

ingredients.en: Half each eggplant and sweet potato, sliced

ingredients.zh: 炸油（芝麻油混合植物油）适量
ingredients.en: Frying oil (sesame blended with vegetable oil)

ingredients.zh: 天つゆ蘸汁（出汁、酱油、味醂）

steps.zh: 虾去壳留尾，腹部斜划 3 刀轻压断筋，防止炸时卷曲。
steps.en: Shell the shrimp keeping the tails; make 3 shallow cuts on the belly and press to break the curl.

steps.zh: 蔬菜切 5 毫米薄片，食材全部擦干水分。
steps.en: Slice vegetables 5mm thick; pat every ingredient completely dry.

steps.zh: 蛋黄加冰水打散，倒入冷藏面粉用筷子粗拌 10 下——留有干粉颗粒正好。
steps.en: Beat the yolk with ice water, add chilled flour and chopstick-stir roughly 10 strokes — lumps are perfect.

steps.zh: 油温升至 170–180°C：滴一滴面糊，沉底一半即浮起为合适温度。
steps.en: Heat oil to 170–180°C: a drop of batter should sink halfway then float right up.

steps.zh: 食材蘸薄糊下锅，先素后荤，每批炸 1–2 分钟。
steps.en: Dip lightly in batter and fry, vegetables first then shrimp, 1–2 minutes per batch.

steps.zh: 沥油立放，配白萝卜泥天つゆ，现炸现吃。
steps.en: Drain upright and serve at once with daikon-grated tentsuyu.

tips.zh: 面糊三要素：冰、粗、少拌——面粉起筋就前功尽弃。
tips.en: Batter's three rules: ice-cold, rough-mixed, barely stirred — develop gluten and it's over.

tips.zh: 油温是灵魂：低了面衣吸油厚重，高了外焦内生，用面糊滴测试最准。
tips.en: Oil temperature is everything: too cool and the crust gets greasy, too hot and it burns raw — trust the batter-drop test.

tips.zh: 天妇罗不蘸盐时配萝卜泥蘸汁，解腻提鲜。
tips.en: When not serving with salt, the daikon-laced tentsuyu cuts the oil and lifts the flavor.

failChecks.zh: 面衣厚重油腻：面糊拌过头起筋，或油温太低。
failChecks.en: Heavy, greasy crust? Over-mixed batter or oil too cool.

failChecks.zh: 不酥脆：面粉没冷藏、水不够冰，温差产生脆度。
failChecks.en: Not crisp? Warm flour or water — the cold-hot shock is what makes it shatter.

failChecks.zh: 虾卷成球：腹部没划刀断筋，炸前一定要压直。
failChecks.en: Shrimp curling into balls? You skipped the belly cuts — straighten them before frying.

culturalStory.zh: 16 世纪葡萄牙传教士把「tempêro」油炸技法带入日本，江户时代的街头摊贩将其变成平民快餐。如今天妇罗已是「和食」技艺的巅峰——东京名店「みかわ是山居」的早乙女哲哉说：天妇罗是面衣之内「蒸」与「炸」同时发生的瞬间艺术，几秒之差，天壤之别。
culturalStory.en: Portuguese missionaries brought the 'tempêro' frying technique to 16th-century Japan, where Edo-era street stalls turned it into fast food. Today tempura is a pinnacle of washoku craft — master Saotome Tetsuya of Mikawa Zezankyo calls it the instant art of 'steaming and frying at once' inside the crust, where seconds separate good from transcendent.
